lines.text: This grass grows almost a meter a day.
lines.caption: This grass grows almost a meter a day.

lines.text: And it isn't even a tree. Wait for the last part.
Some bamboo can shoot up ninety-one centimeters in twenty-four hours.
lines.caption: Some bamboo can shoot up 91 cm in 24 hours.

lines.text: That's nearly four centimeters every hour.
lines.caption: That's nearly 4 cm every hour.

lines.text: Its cells fill with water, so each section stretches long, fast.
The tallest kinds reach about thirty meters.
lines.caption: The tallest kinds reach about 30 meters.

lines.text: And bamboo isn't a tree at all. It's a giant grass.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
